Title text 'Figure 1: CAMS has the lowest error of the gridded products on each of the four row sets'
text.tspan: Figure 1: CAMS has the lowest error of the gridded products on each of

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each product's own mean absolute error, sorted best first within its block. Compare products only within a block: each block is scored on its own rows, so an error in one block is not comparable with an error in another. Overlapping intervals do not make two products equal: the intervals are wide mainly because every product's error swings together from month to month, a swing that Figure 2's paired contrasts cancel. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire. Lighter, hollow rows are CAMS and ERA5, repeated in every block as a yardstick and scored on that block's own rows.'
text.tspan: Each product's own mean absolute error, sorted best first within its block.
Compare products only within a block: each block is scored on its own rows, so an error in one block is not
comparable with an error in another.
Overlapping intervals do not make two products equal: the intervals are wide mainly because every product's error
swings together from month to month, a swing that Figure 2's paired contrasts cancel.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months.
Lighter, hollow rows are CAMS and ERA5, repeated in every block as a yardstick and scored on that block's own rows.
